doc.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe and Rayhill thank each other and wrap up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Maybe we should try to get a good jazz band together for that event, don’t you think? Well it’s been a great pleasure talking to you. I hope we covered everything.
I enjoyed myself, just like having a nice leisurely talk with a good old friend, and you are.
Well thanks for all the great stuff you put on the airwaves for so many years. It’s like a Central NY institution.
Well I love it. Thank you.
Okay. Thank you very much. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
